about.title: Made in Kuala Lumpur, sent across Malaysia
about.body:
Oh! Gift began with a simple frustration: corporate gifting in Malaysia too often meant the same tired hamper, wrapped in a hurry, arriving late. We thought the moment deserved better.

From our studio in KL we curate every box by hand — sourcing from makers we have actually met, choosing packaging that feels considered, and checking each gift before it leaves us. The result is something a client is genuinely pleased to open, and a company is proud to have sent.
